ALTER TABLE recovery_cases
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS third_party_insurer_address TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS third_party_insurer_contact VARCHAR(255),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS third_party_insurer_policy_ref VARCHAR(100),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS third_party_insurer_is_on_kinga TINYINT DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS third_party_address TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS third_party_id_number VARCHAR(50),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS third_party_phone VARCHAR(50),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS third_party_insurer_phone VARCHAR(50),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS police_report_number VARCHAR(100),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS police_station VARCHAR(255),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS police_report_extracted_at VARCHAR(50),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS recovery_target ENUM('insurer','individual','unknown') DEFAULT 'unknown';
